svg.aria-label: Current 33 by 36 millimeter FPGA board, front and mirrored back
svg.title: 33 × 36 mm USB-C FPGA PCB · routing development
svg.desc: Native KiCad geometry, c2bb9d1de754b65ebb3076b0b2c97529bc77afb4e5efad52e5762c3a9af2ac76. 91/116 FPGA-to-connector paths connected, with one external analog reservation and 268 assigned-net gaps. Electrical and timing verification remain open; not manufacturing release.
